rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an unfair or preconceived opinion, including bias against a group.

example.english: You're showing prejudice by reaching a conclusion before learning the facts.
example.traditional: 你未了解件事就咁快落定論，真係有偏見。
example.jyutping: nei5 mei6 liu5 gaai2 gin6 si6 zau6 gam3 faai3 lok6 ding6 leon6 zan1 hai6 jau5 pin1 gin3

rows.note: Use this when stressing an opinion formed beforehand and resistant to the facts.

example.english: I used to have deep prejudice against vocational-school students, but later realized I was wrong.
example.traditional: 我以前對讀職業學校嘅人成見好深，後來先知自己錯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji5 cin4 deoi3 duk6 zik1 jip6 hok6 haau6 ge3 jan4 sing4 gin3 hou2 sam1 hau6 loi4 sin1 zi1 zi6 gei2 co3

rows.note: Use this for prejudice against a particular group, especially when it involves discriminatory treatment rather than merely a private opinion.

example.english: Refusing to hire wheelchair users is prejudice.
example.traditional: 公司唔應該因為人哋坐輪椅就唔請佢哋，呢種就係歧視。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 m4 jing1 goi1 jan1 wai6 jan4 dei6 co5 leon4 ji2 zau6 m4 cing2 keoi5 dei6 ni1 zung2 zau6 hai6 kei4 si6
